info.title: Voice Support Platform operations console API
info.description: GENERATED by platform/src/protocol/generate-schemas.ts from the zod console contract (platform/src/console-api/schemas.ts and contract.ts); do not edit. Workforce SSO with MFA; roles are server-established (x-vsp-roles) and enforced server-side. Content-free: no transcript, audio, recording, raw query or task token field exists.
